# netactuate_firewall_rule (Resource)

Manages a Firewall Rule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_firewall_rule" "example" {
  action          = "ACCEPT"
  enabled         = true
  firewall_set_id = 12345
  ip_version      = "IPv4"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) Rule action (ACCEPT or DROP)
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this rule is active
- `firewall_set_id` (Number) The ID of the parent firewall set
- `ip_version` (String) IP version for this rule (IPv4 or IPv6)

### Optional

- `admin_comment` (String) Comment for this rule
- `destination_net` (List of String) Destination CIDRs to match
- `destination_port_end` (Number) End of destination port range
- `destination_port_start` (Number) Start of destination port range
- `direction` (String) Traffic direction (always IN per backend)
- `icmp_type` (String) ICMP type (echo-request or echo-reply), only when protocol is icmp
- `protocol` (String) Protocol to match (tcp, udp, or icmp)
- `rule_priority` (Number) Rule priority (auto-assigned if not set)
- `source_net` (List of String) Source CIDRs to match
- `source_port_end` (Number) End of source port range
- `source_port_start` (Number) Start of source port range
- `sync_after_publish` (Boolean) Whether to sync rules to attached VMs after publishing

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `rule_id` (Number) The firewall rule ID assigned by the API

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_firewall_rule.example 12345
```
